name: Lesson 3: Languages used in requests, offers and opinions
descriptionHtml:
1. Question type

In this part of the test, you are asked to choose the correct responses to offer, request and opinion questions. 

 

2. Guide to answer

- Social interaction, including offers, requests and opinions, is a common feature of Part 2: Be aware of the language commonly used in these situations.

- Common distractors for this section include the use of the same word/similar sounds or incorrect meaning: Noticing these types of wrong answers can help you to choose the correct one.

- Repeat each question and answer choice silently after you hear it. This will help you to

remember and compare the meanings.
